Aisha Oduya  
Berlin, Germany | +49 123 456 7890 | aisha.oduya@example.com | linkedin.com/in/aisheaoduya | github.com/aisheaoduya  

A seasoned backend engineer with a decade of experience in fintech, specializing in scalable cloud architectures, microservices, and high-performance systems. Over the past 10 years, I’ve led the design and deployment of mission-critical backend services, optimized cloud infrastructure costs, and mentored junior engineers across multiple teams. My work balances technical depth with operational efficiency, ensuring systems that handle millions of transactions daily while maintaining reliability and security.  

**Technical Skills**  
- **AWS**: Architectured payment gateway APIs for NexaPay, reducing latency by 30% and enabling global scalability. Mentored 5+ engineers on best practices for EC2, S3, and Lambda.  
- **Go**: Developed core components of NexaPay’s transaction processing engine, achieving 99.99% uptime during peak loads. Refactored legacy Python services to Go, improving response times by 40%.  
- **Microservices**: Designed and scaled a monolith to microservices transition at PayFlow Dynamics, supporting 1.2M daily transactions. Implemented circuit breakers and retries for fault tolerance.  
- **PostgreSQL**: Optimized database queries for FinTech Solutions, reducing average query latency by 25% and improving data consistency across distributed systems.  
- **REST API design**: Built and documented APIs for NexaPay’s third-party integrations, ensuring compliance with PCI-DSS standards and reducing onboarding time for partners by 50%.  
- **Docker**: Containerized 80% of PayFlow’s backend services, streamlining deployment and reducing environment configuration errors.  
- **Cloud cost optimization**: Reduced AWS spend by 18% at NexaPay by implementing auto-scaling and spot instance strategies.  
- **Prometheus/Grafana**: Set up monitoring dashboards for NexaPay’s payment pipelines, enabling real-time anomaly detection and proactive incident resolution.  
- **CI/CD pipelines**: Automated 70% of deployment workflows at PayFlow using Jenkins, cutting release cycles from weeks to hours.  
- **Linux administration**: Maintained production servers for FinTech Solutions, resolving 95% of infrastructure issues before SLA breaches.  

**Professional Experience**  
*Staff Backend Engineer*  
**NexaPay Technologies** (2020–Present)  
- Led the development of NexaPay’s core payment processing system, integrating AWS Lambda and DynamoDB for real-time fraud detection.  
- Collaborated with DevOps to implement Prometheus for monitoring, reducing mean time to resolve (MTTR) by 35%.  
- Optimized PostgreSQL indexing and query performance, achieving 20% faster transaction settlement times.  
- Mentored 3 junior engineers, guiding them through Go best practices and microservices architecture.  

*Senior Backend Engineer*

- Refactored monolithic Python applications into modular Go services, improving system resilience and reducing downtime by 40%.  
- Implemented CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, reducing deployment errors by 60% and accelerating feature rollouts.

- Developed backend services for a mobile banking app, leveraging PostgreSQL and RESTful APIs to support 500K+ users.  
- Collaborated with DevOps to automate server provisioning, cutting deployment time by 50%.  

**Projects**  
- **NexaPay Payment Gateway Optimization**: Redesigned API routing to reduce latency, resulting in a 30% improvement in transaction throughput.  
- **Microservices Migration at PayFlow**: Spearheaded the transition of a legacy monolith to microservices, increasing system scalability by 2x.  
- **Cloud Cost Analysis Tool**: Built a dashboard to track AWS spending, identifying $500K+ in annual savings through resource optimization.
